title: The Riverside Shakespeare, 2nd edition
author_or_editor: G. Blakemore Evans (ed.) with J. J. M. Tobin
reliability_notes: The standard American one-volume complete works; used for Shakespearean play texts, dates, and the canon of collaborative plays.

title: The Oxford Shakespeare: The Complete Works, 2nd edition
reliability_notes: The standard British complete works; used for play texts, dating, and attributions, including the collaborative canon.

title: The Cambridge Companion to Shakespeare
author_or_editor: Margreta de Grazia and Stanley Wells (eds.)
reliability_notes: A collection of critical essays on Shakespeare's works and their contexts; used for interpretive framing and canonical selection.

title: The Cambridge Companion to English Renaissance Drama, 2nd edition
author_or_editor: A. R. Braunmuller and Michael Hattaway (eds.)
reliability_notes: The standard collaborative reference for the non-Shakespearean drama of 1558–1642; used for the playwrights, companies, and genres of the public and private theatres.

title: The Cambridge Companion to Christopher Marlowe
reliability_notes: Essays on Marlowe's plays, poems, and translations; used for the Marlowe records.

title: The Cambridge Companion to Ben Jonson
reliability_notes: Essays on Jonson's drama, poetry, masques, and criticism; used for the Jonson records.

title: The Cambridge Companion to John Donne
reliability_notes: Essays on Donne's poetry, prose, and sermons; used for the Donne records.

title: The Cambridge Companion to Spenser
reliability_notes: Essays on Spenser's poetry and prose and their contexts; used for the Spenser records.
